return-response.set-body: @(new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(new JProperty("message", "The audio exceeds the ${max_request_bytes} byte limit for this capability."), new JProperty("type", "invalid_request_error"), new JProperty("code", "payload_too_large")))).ToString())

when.set-body: @(new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(new JProperty("message", "The backend AI service returned an error."), new JProperty("type", "api_error"), new JProperty("code", context.Response.StatusCode == 503 ? "service_unavailable" : "backend_error")))).ToString())
